verdict.rationale: Evidence shows concrete cross-border matters: advising Langdock on relocating its seat to Germany and establishing an SE holding structure (a flip/redomiciliation), advising Isembard on German market entry, a bilingual (German/English) notary, and dedicated content on the German FDI regime and cross-jurisdictional differences in venture deals. This substantiates cross-border venture-related work, though it's Germany-centric (offices only in Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich) with no evidence of a broader multi-jurisdictional office network or explicit examples of complex multi-jurisdiction financings with syndicates of international investors. Missing for 10: evidence of multi-jurisdiction financing deals with international investor syndicates, and any network/coverage beyond Germany-inbound cross-border matters.
